column1: # Symbol providers for the iOS 27 USB surface check.
# Feed this to `kc-surface.py object --providers` so each unresolved symbol in
# an object file is reported with the patch that used to define it in the
#   1  symbol as llvm-nm prints it for a Mach-O object (leading underscore)
#   2  provider: where the definition lives, patch file and line
#   3  axis: what the symbol is for, so a missing one can be triaged
# None of these exist in the iOS 27 series: the 104 patches applied to the
# 12377 kernel (xnu-inputs.json / xnu-patches.list) contain no USB patch and
# none of the diagnostic patches below. Every row therefore fails on a 27
# build until the patch is carried over.
